# ADR trigger notes — R4.7c (2026-10-22)

Re-homed fired-trigger records (landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01;
precedent 0b3ca91 / R4.7a's `2026-10-22-adr-0303-0351-trigger.md`). Source:
the R4.7c run ledger (`docs/build/runs/R4.7c.md`) is the narrative home.

## ADR-0346 — revisit trigger (a): FIRED

Trigger text: *"Reopen if (a) a real external observability backend lands
and the subscriber's loopback fixture graduates to a live sink (the egress
mediation contract stays — only the transport widens)…"*

R4.7c lands exactly that shape:

- **Real observability backend on the loopback** — the operator-provisioned
  HUMAN-H6 collector (`jaegertracing/jaeger:2.22.0`, OTLP/HTTP `:4318`,
  query API `:16686`, USD 0) is the live sink. `scripts/live-verify.sh
  otel-live` starts the container, drives a short local run whose
  `gen_ai`-lowered convention spans ride one OTLP/HTTP (JSON)
  `ExportTraceServiceRequest`, then queries
  `GET :16686/api/v3/traces/{traceId}` for the run's derived trace ID —
  read-back is the delivery proof. Executed 2026-10-22 → **pass**;
  evidence `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-22-otel-live.json` +
  transcript (USD 0; `skipped(<reason>)` on any absent
  docker/image/readiness leg — never a fabricated pass).
- **The mediation contract stayed — only the transport widened** —
  `SinkWire::OtlpTraces` (`crates/hh-embed/src/subscriber.rs`) spells the
  same durable delta as an OTLP document; the same single `net_egress`
  `EgressRequest` rides `EgressMediator::handle` (decided/requested rows
  and the `network.calls` charge unchanged). `SinkWire::BatchJson` and the
  R2.14 fixture ceiling are untouched. No crate opens its own wire; the
  new OTLP lowering (`crates/hh-telemetry/src/otlp.rs`) is a pure fold —
  `hh-telemetry` still never holds a second store.
- **Delivered means collector-acknowledged** — a forwarded 2xx lands
  `measurement.export.delivered`; a forwarded non-2xx is the new
  `PollOutcome::NotAcknowledged` (wire fired, never a delivery row);
  refusals stay `PollOutcome::Refused` (durable `security.egress.*` rows,
  no delivery claim). The policy gates are the same spellings —
  `sampled_keep`, `cap_strings`, `ExportBatch::loss_report_ref` reused
  (CC1); the one free-text-adjacent convention member
  (`gen_ai.evaluation.explanation`) is withheld with a named
  `content_class_withheld` loss when `content` is not a declared class.

Triggers (b) — OQ-115's trace-id derivation — and (c) — deeper
`turn_phase_profile` nesting — are **unchanged**: the ADR's `hh`
tracestate member and the `trace_id`/`span_id` derivations are exactly
the landed spellings (trace-id derivation changes stayed out of scope).

BL-31 discharge: the row's live-sink member — "ADR-0346 live
observability-sink condition" — is met by the executed `otel-live` leg
(loopback collector, USD 0, read-back verified). The row's remaining
members (production TLS-terminating transport) stay open as before.
